title: Product videos
description: Produce complete product tutorials and single-feature shorts with real UI recordings, cinematic zoom/cursor effects, ElevenLabs narration and HyperFrames branding.
input: Product URL and demo access, task or feature, audience, language and voice, brand assets, output format and existing usage authorization.
output: Verified MP4, captions, thumbnail, YouTube metadata, editable sources, scene manifest and QA evidence.
dependencies: Cursorful and connected Chrome controls, or a supported cinematic recorder
ElevenLabs API, SDK or official CLI

provenance.origin: Original Agentsteam skill based on primary-source research; external tools and skill contracts are linked in the references, not bundled.

environments.name: Codex app
environments.task: Independent planning-only dry run for a fictional full tutorial and portrait feature short
environments.limitations: Official skill validation, local-reference checks and JSON examples passed. A separate agent produced manifests and timelines from fixture metadata. No product recording, paid narration, HyperFrames rendering or YouTube upload was tested; other environments remain unverified.

changelog.summary: Initial English package for full tutorials and feature shorts, with capture/zoom, narration/timing, HyperFrames and delivery references.
